Official Publications & Historical Guides

Priory Publications & Bookstore

From scholarly medieval Latin transcriptions to visitor trail guides and Charnwood biodiversity anthologies. Every book purchased directly supports ongoing stone conservation.

Payment & Postal Fulfillment Notice

No direct online credit card processing at this time. To keep overheads zero, our charity operates on voluntary mail order. Payment is accepted via cheques payable to "Grace Dieu Priory Trust" or via bank transfer on request.

How to Pay by Cheque or Post

To order any of our publications, you may submit the inquiry form above or post your order directly. Please make all cheques payable to "Grace Dieu Priory Trust". Send your order details (book title, quantity, and delivery address) to:

Ann Petty · Publications OfficerSole Supplier for the Friends of Grace Dieu PrioryTelephone Inquiries: 01530 831895Email: annpetty1948@yahoo.co.uk or shop@gracedieupriory.org.uk

Every copy is packed by volunteers. Proceeds directly protect our 13th-century stone arches.

Grace Dieu Priory
Augustinian Canonesses · c. 1239

"Free to visit, cared for by volunteers for over 20 years."

Managed by The Friends of Grace Dieu Priory, a volunteer-run body dedicated to conserving the 13th-century ruins and keeping the site open to the public without statutory funding.

Partnership

Official Partner: Charnwood Forest Geopark, collaborating as our regional landscape strives toward UNESCO Global Geopark status.

facebook.com/gracedieupriory

Visitor Code

Leave No TracePlease take all of your litter home with you. There are no public waste bins on the ancient monument ruins.
Dog WalkersDogs welcome on leads. A dedicated bin is located at the Bull's Head car park for dog litter bags (strictly none on-site).
Strict Site Policy: Paranormal events and ghost walks are expressly forbidden by the Grace Dieu Priory Trust across the entire priory site and surrounding lands.
